media.alt: Dr Nafis Sadik to address Reproductive Health- Seminar at AKU

content.text: Pakistan has one of the highest fertility rates in Asia which has led to a spiralling population growth rate. To address this, the Government of Pakistan has adopted a reproductive health package emanating from the recommendations of the International Conference on Population & Development held in Cairo in 1994.

The highlights of Pakistan's Reproductive Health Package will be presented at a seminar on"Pakistan's Reproductive Health Agenda" on December 21, 1999 at the Aga Khan University (AKU). Dr Nafis Sadik, Executive Director, UNFPA, will be chief guest and keynote speaker at the seminar, which will include national experts and will be open to participant comments and discussion. Attendance at the seminar is free of cost and is open to all academics and professionals working in the fields of population and health. Further information can be obtained from AKU's Community Health Sciences Department.
